props.title: Let's get in touch
props.text: Sometimes change begins with a single sentence. If you long for more calm after long, full days, feel your back or simply want to come back to yourself – write to me. Together we'll find out what's good for you right now, completely without pressure. You can reach me by phone and via WhatsApp at +49 163 139 1059 or by email at runabulla@gmail.com. You'll find my studio at Sinnergie, Schulzestr. 1, 13187 Berlin-Pankow – a protected, warm space where you may be just as you are. Feel free to come by for a tea. I look forward to seeing you. Registration requested.
